name: Classic
description: A traditional, centred layout in a conservative serif. Clear hierarchy that suits almost any profession.

name: Modern
description: A clean, contemporary sans-serif page with a teal accent, timeline-style experience and skill tags.

name: Minimal
description: Generous whitespace and quiet section labels in the margin. No rules, no decoration, the writing leads.

name: Executive
description: A formal navy header with gold detailing, an executive profile and a core competencies grid for senior roles.

name: Creative
description: An expressive split-weight name, terracotta accent and label tabs. Distinctive, yet plain text throughout.

name: Academic
description: A CV-style layout that leads with education, for students, graduates, researchers and academic profiles.

name: Compact
description: A dense, efficient layout with one-line entries that fits substantial experience on fewer pages.

name: Elegant
description: Refined serif typography, small caps and subtle hairline details, with a centred, balanced composition.

name: Professional Two-Column
description: A sidebar for contact details, skills, education and languages, beside a main column for experience.

name: Simple ATS
description: Plain single-column text with standard headings and no decoration, built to parse cleanly in applicant tracking systems.
